receivedEvidence: Historical SES Delivery, original Listmonk campaign/subscriber UUID headers and verified recipient identity
timeFormat: Canonical ISO8601 UTC with milliseconds; readers normalize verified timestamps before projection
nativeEventEvidence: Individual open/click events with original campaign/person identity and timestamp at the same asOf
countRule: R, R intersect O, R intersect C, R minus O, R minus C; deduplicated by canonical subscriber UUID
coverage: All receipt PK pages through the fixed cap, zero unresolved identities, complete native event projection at the same asOf
unknown: Every count is null and audience eligibility is false until all source and identity proofs are complete
productionBlockers: No admitted receipt projection joining campaign and subscriber identities in the gateway
infra_leitura has no SELECT columns on campaign_views or link_clicks
API16 activity returns count/max without a common asOf; it cannot prove negative audiences
forbiddenWorkarounds: Raw SQL through the closed transport
